reviewedInvariants: Android source-package lookup occurs outside ReplyDispatchLock, adds no permissions or asynchronous capability dispatch, and leaves package/key/token/flags unchanged.
Actual serialized envelope budget drops icon then label rather than changing original text/actions. Icon bytes are stripped from durable replay and tombstones are not decorated.
Mac validates Base64 size/canonical encoding, PNG signature/chunks/static frame count/type and dimensions before decoding; raster output and phone badge are bounded.
Mac phone label comes from current matching active pairing, not the incoming decorative payload. HFP notifications remain undecorated with authoritative call actions unchanged.
Owned staging uses random directories, a128-pending cap and cleanup after OS submission completion; synchronous staging failure falls back to ordinary delivery.
An attachment add failure retries once without artwork only under current submission ownership. Replacement, tombstone, pairing context clear, reply and dismiss revoke artwork retry authority.
Reply validation and one-shot context consumption are unchanged. Source-app decoration cannot authorize a reply or HFP action.

Mac generator preserves link geometry and switches to fixed blue/white. Android manifest selects an adaptive icon with the same palette and transparent white foreground; launcher masking is platform-owned.

lateReviewAdjudications.finding: Staging retained until delayed or missing OS add callback
lateReviewAdjudications.reason: Owned staging is bounded to128 pending items; overflow omits artwork. Completion removes remaining owned files, and stale owned directories older than24h are cleaned on startup. A missing callback can retain files for that process lifetime; no tighter elapsed-time guarantee claimed. Deleting earlier could violate attachment handoff. No new timer/cache subsystem warranted.

lateReviewAdjudications.finding: Dismiss does not explicitly remove pending notification requests
lateReviewAdjudications.reason: Existing dismiss path removed message bookkeeping; new code also revokes artwork retry authority. Actual dismissal concerns a delivered notification. No evidence shows a new pending duplicate or resurrection requiring an additional removal operation. Keep source frozen.
